name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Builder
description: Builds MiniMax H3 prompts. One freeform Action field holds the whole scene and a toolbar writes into it in the format H3 expects - shot markers, timestamps, camera sentences with the anchor in the middle, dialogue and voiceover with the spec's required phrasing and closed-lips clause, <scenetrans> at both sides of a cut, <cutoff>, and on-screen text quoted verbatim. Everything the buttons write is ordinary text you can edit in place. Nothing is remembered between presses: shot numbering, camera continuation and the carried-line pick-up are all read back out of the field, so editing by hand stays correct. Base modes write the three-field schema, a reference-mode switch writes the six-section Ref2VA format, and speaker IDs are bound to the right label at build time so the switch keeps working after the action is written. An Insert-time validation pass warns about broken tags, shot numbering, timestamps and unknown speaker IDs without ever blocking. Buttons in the Audio section hand the scene to WanGP's Prompt Enhancer for a soundscape or a score. The whole form is saved to disk as you work and restored after a crash. Character creator per subject, sliding-window support, combined cast and subjects list, time of day, and audio references for voice, ambience and score.
